_comment_allowedHosts: Empty list = accept any source the engine (yt-dlp) supports. Fill it, e.g. ["archive.org", "vimeo.com"], to lock this server down to sources you are allowed to download from.
_comment_maxDuration: Refuse videos longer than this many seconds (default 4 hours).
_comment_maxConcurrent: How many downloads may run at the same time.
_comment_apiToken: Optional. If you set a string here, the API requires that token. Open the app once as /?token=YOUR-TOKEN and it is remembered in the browser.
_comment_maxQualityHeight: Highest resolution offered in the quality list (sources above this are capped).
